mapper.select: select a.id,role_name as name,role_code as code,role_type as roleType,a.tenant_id as tenantId from t_sys_role_info a,t_sys_user_role_r b where a.id=b.role_id and b.user_id=@userId and b.status=1 and a.status=1

select a.user_id as userId,b.id as id,b.tenant_name as tenantName,b.tenant_code as tenantCode,b.org_id as orgId,c.org_name as orgName,c.org_code as orgCode,a.type,b.logo from t_tenant_user_r a,t_tenant_info b,t_sys_org_info c where a.status=@status and b.status=@status and c.status=@status and a.TENANT_ID=b.id and c.id=b.org_id and a.user_id=@userId
select count(1) as count from t_sys_enterprise a,t_sys_employer b,t_sys_org_info c where a.owner_id=b.id and c.ent_id=a.id and c.id=@orgId and b.id=@employerId
